eligible.text: Based on the information provided, you may meet the core qualification requirements for Portugal's D7 Passive Income Visa.

needs_review.text: Eligibility cannot be confirmed automatically. Your Portugal D7 Passive Income Visa information requires manual review.

not_eligible.text: Based on the information provided, you do not currently appear to meet one or more core Portugal D7 Passive Income Visa requirements.

insufficient_passive_income.text: Based on the annual passive or own income provided, you do not currently appear to meet the Portugal D7 income threshold for your applicant route.

employment_or_active_work_income_not_acc.text: Portugal's D7 pathway must be supported by passive or own income. Based on the information provided, active work income does not appear to satisfy this pathway.

portugal_accommodation_12_months_unavail.text: Portugal's D7 pathway requires permanent accommodation in Portugal for at least 12 months. Based on the information provided, this requirement is not currently met.

passport_validity_below_minimum.text: Based on the passport validity provided, you do not currently appear to meet the Portugal D7 passport-validity requirement.

lawful_residence_where_applying_unavaila.text: If applying outside the country of nationality, Portugal D7 screening requires proof of lawful residence where applying. Based on the information provided, this requirement is not currently met.

health_travel_insurance_unavailable.text: Portugal D7 applicants must have health or travel insurance covering medical expenses, urgent medical assistance, and possible repatriation unless an exception applies. Without qualifying coverage, eligibility cannot be confirmed.

police_clearance_unavailable.text: Portugal D7 applicants age 16 or older generally need a criminal record certificate. Based on the information provided, this requirement is not currently met.

text: You may be a good fit for Portugal's D7 Passive Income Visa.
The next step is to verify your passive or own income, dependent income calculation if applicable, 12-month accommodation, passport, insurance, and police clearance before preparing an application.
Your answers need manual review before Portugal D7 Passive Income Visa eligibility can be confirmed.
The team should follow up by email with next steps or any follow-up questions.
You do not currently appear to meet one or more mandatory Portugal D7 Passive Income Visa qualification requirements.

If your passive or own income, accommodation, passport validity, insurance, police clearance, or family route answers change, you can complete the eligibility check again or ask the team about alternative Portugal pathways.
Your applicant route needs manual review.
The team should confirm whether you are applying individually or with family dependents because family cases affect the D7 income threshold and documentation.
Your dependent income calculation needs manual review.
The team should confirm the number of additional adult dependents and child or dependent non-minor dependents so the 100% / 50% / 30% threshold can be calculated correctly.
Your annual passive or own-income amount needs manual review.
The team should verify the numeric EUR amount before confirming whether the Portugal D7 income threshold is met.
Your passive or own-income source needs manual review.
The team should verify whether your income source fits Portugal D7 categories such as pension, rental property income, dividends, royalties, financial investments, intellectual property, or savings.
Your income evidence needs manual review.

The team should verify whether your bank statements, income proof, pension proof, investment income proof, property income proof, or royalty/intellectual-property income proof can support the Portugal D7 case.
Your Portugal accommodation status needs manual review.
The team should verify your plan to arrange accommodation in Portugal for at least 12 months before eligibility is confirmed.
Your passport validity needs manual review.
The team should confirm the passport validity period before Portugal D7 eligibility is finalized.
Your lawful residence where applying needs manual review.
The team should verify your residence status if you are applying outside your country of nationality.
Your health or travel insurance status needs manual review.
The team should verify whether your coverage satisfies medical expense, urgent assistance, and possible repatriation requirements, or whether an exception applies.
Your police clearance status needs manual review.
The team should confirm whether the required criminal record certificate can be obtained.
Your criminal record answer needs manual review.
The team should determine whether any disclosed or uncertain record affects Portugal D7 eligibility.
Your AIMA residence-stage acknowledgment needs manual review.
The team should confirm that you understand the post-approval residence title step after D7 visa issuance.
